segments.content:
Chapter 59 Snatching Your Guitar

"Wandering, on the road~"

"Are you leaving? ViaVia~"

"Fragile, and proud~"

"That was once how I was~"

The simple melody flowed through the microphone, spreading out from the speakers across the entire field.

Li Luo's lips were close to the microphone, the lyrics flowing out peacefully and gently.

When the lyrics reached "Fragile, and proud, that was once how I was," Li Luo’s entire being was instantly immersed in the song.

He recalled how he was at 15 in his past life. Before the high school entrance exams, that sensitive guy who had pushed Ying Chanxi to the ground was probably just as the lyrics described.

"I once crossed mountains and seas~"

"And also passed through seas of people~"

"Everything I once possessed~"

"In a blink of an eye, all vanished like smoke~"

"I was once lost, disappointed, and had lost all direction~"

"Until I saw that being ordinary was the only answer~"

If the 15-year-old Li Luo heard this song, he would probably only think it sounded nice, without knowing why.

The 35-year-old Li Luo, now back at the starting point of 15, felt his young heart still beating violently, its strings plucked by these lyrics.

"It's so good." Qiao Xinyan felt the power in the song and couldn't help but sigh, "The boy who sang just now was also pretty good, and Xie Shuchen sang very well too, but I don't know why, neither of them had the same flavor as Li Luo."

"Quiet." Ying Chanxi covered Qiao Xinyan's mouth, her gaze burning as she looked at Li Luo standing on the field in the distance.

The light on the field was dim at that moment, but it was as if Li Luo himself was glowing, firmly imprinted in her eyes.

Did she even need Qiao Xinyan to tell her whether Li Luo sang well?

Unfortunately, Class One was still a bit far from Class Eight. Even with the help of the speakers, it certainly wasn't as clear as listening up close.

But even so, daring to sing in front of all the students on the field, and singing so well, was indeed something that could easily win people's favor.

A girl next to them couldn't help but whisper, "He looks so handsome from the back. Is that the class monitor of Class Eight? I haven't heard of him before."

"I've heard of him. Someone in their class was my junior high classmate, and they were bragging to me these past two days that their class monitor provides free cold drinks and ice cream every afternoon. I'm so jealous," said another girl.

"Damn! That's so nice!"

"I think he's our class monitor's cousin, right? I remember someone mentioning it. Why don't you ask the class monitor to introduce you?"

"Haha~ No way, you go ask."

Hearing the discussions of the girls around her, Ying Chanxi, who had been feeling a little happy listening to Li Luo sing, now frowned. She glanced at her classmates beside her, suddenly feeling unhappy again.

And just then, Li Luo finished his song.

But he didn't stop playing the guitar, transitioning naturally into the next song.

Only this time, he didn't continue to occupy the microphone. Instead, he waved toward Yan Zhusheng, making way for her at the mic.

Hearing the melody in her ears, Yan Zhusheng naturally stood up and walked to Li Luo's side.

Swaying with the rhythm, she slowly closed her eyes.

When she opened them again, Yan Zhusheng was no longer her usual impassive self. As if a dragon had its eyes dotted, she suddenly came to life—

"My world~"

"Is beautiful only because of you~"

"My sky~"

"Is not dark only because of you~"

A vocal line that was steadier and clearer than Li Luo's, with a brighter and more ethereal timbre, spread out from the speakers like a tidal wave.

"Give me wings~"

"So that I can soar~"

"Give me strength~"

"It is you who makes me strong~"

At this moment, Yan Zhusheng seemed like a different person.

The students of Class Eight stared blankly at Yan Zhusheng up front, watching as she untied her ponytail, freely flicking her long hair, followed by a soaring high note that shot straight to everyone's heads.

If Li Luo's singing just now was a calm and steady narrative, then Yan Zhusheng at this moment was like a queen who had blown up the stage, unleashing all her energy.

The students of Class Eight could never have imagined that Yan Zhusheng, who was usually as cool and quiet as a snow lotus, would transform into such an unrestrained and confident person after getting a hold of the microphone.

It was as if there was a light in her eyes.

The students from the other classes on the field were also quite shaken, almost thinking they were at some concert.

Yan Zhusheng's voice was like a clear lake, yet also like a speeding arrow. Her high notes were clear and bright, yet full of power, not the least bit flimsy.

Halfway through the song, after entering the interlude, Yan Zhusheng regained her senses slightly. She glanced at Li Luo and held out her hand to him.

"What do you mean?" Li Luo blinked, a little confused.

Then he saw Yan Zhusheng walk up to him, snatch the guitar from his hands, and hug it to her chest. She immediately launched into a display of skill, bringing the song's rhythm to a new climax.

"Holding a dream, flying forward~"

"No escape, no retreat~"

"You are the fortress on my road to success~"

Yan Zhusheng's fingers flew and danced across the guitar strings. The notes she played were clearly similar to what Li Luo had just played, but they gave the illusion of being fuller and richer.

Especially the fancy fingerwork during the interlude, which was something Li Luo had never even learned in his past life.

"Give me wings!"

"So that I can soar!"

"Give me strength!"

"It is you who makes me strong!"

Entering the second chorus, Yan Zhusheng raised the key by two steps, completely in a state of being high on her own singing.

The students on the field were also roused by her, clapping along to the rhythm, and some even sang along, turning the scene into a massive sing-along.

Li Luo, who had his guitar snatched, stood to one side, clapping to the beat and smiling as he watched the scene.

He was much more familiar with Yan Zhusheng in this state.

After all, the two of them once lived under the same roof, where Yan Zhusheng would sing and Li Luo would be in charge of recording.

If the usual Yan Zhusheng was a cool and quiet beauty, then the her holding a microphone and an instrument was the music queen in control of the entire stage.

As long as there was music, she could completely immerse herself in it, entering a state of total self-forgetfulness and wholeheartedly enjoying it.

The Yan Zhusheng of this moment was pure.

After singing the last line of the song, Yan Zhusheng closed her eyes again, her chest heaving slightly.

When she reopened them, she wiped all expression from her face, turning back into her usual cool self. After returning the guitar to Li Luo, she silently sat back down.

"Let's thank our classmate Yan Zhusheng for her performance of 'The Most Beautiful Sun'. Did everyone enjoy it?"

"Yes!"

"Sing another one!"

"Don't stop!"

Li Luo had already noticed the head instructor's movements, so he said with a smile, "That's all for today. There will be plenty of opportunities in the future. Everyone, happy military training!"

As his voice fell, the head instructor's whistle blew, signaling the end of the day's military training.

Perhaps because Yan Zhusheng's singing was so stunning, many people were still wanting more, for once hoping that the military training could last a little longer.

"Why did you snatch my guitar just now?" On the way back to the classroom, Li Luo turned his head and asked Yan Zhusheng.

Yan Zhusheng blinked and said seriously, "You weren't playing it well. It was affecting my singing."

Li Luo: "...You really shouldn't say such hurtful things."

"You asked," Yan Zhusheng said, "I didn't even mention that you sang two notes wrong."

"Aren't you mentioning it now?"

"Mm..." Yan Zhusheng fell into thought, "I guess I did. I'll take that back then."

"Oh, thank you so much."

Back in the classroom, Li Luo packed his things, slung his guitar on his back, and prepared to go home.

Just then, Yan Zhusheng glanced at the guitar and said, "You need to practice more to maintain your feel for it. I noticed your hands were a little stiff today."

"Okay, Teacher Yan is right."

"I'm not a teacher," Yan Zhusheng corrected, "but if you need, I can teach you."

"Do you charge?"

"I don't want money."

Looking at Yan Zhusheng's innocent eyes, Li Luo swallowed the many jokes on the tip of his tongue. "Alright, you can teach me how to play guitar from now on."

Waving his hand, Li Luo said goodbye to Yan Zhusheng and walked out of the classroom with his guitar case.

Outside the door, Ying Chanxi had just come downstairs to find him.

"Let's go, to the field." Li Luo patted Ying Chanxi's shoulder.

"Why are we going to the field?" Ying Chanxi was a little confused.

"My guitar teacher told me to practice more," Li Luo said as he walked downstairs toward the field. "I need an audience right now. Are you willing?"

"Is that so? Of course, I'm willing~"
